root_idea.summary: The root centers on one thing winding, folding, or becoming joined with another, yielding ideas of wrapping, entanglement, dense intermixture, and gathering.
root_idea.development: The evidence develops from physical winding and enclosure to tangled or dense growth, people gathered from different groups, bodily compactness, and figurative complication.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Standalone Quran-attested adjectival form; no secure singular citation form is supplied for this usage.

senses.definition: To become intertwined or closely joined, one part with another.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ, the ساق is described as becoming joined or entwined with the other ساق.

senses.definition: Interwoven and dense, as vegetation whose growth is closely intertwined.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافًا of gardens whose trees intertwine through their abundance.

senses.definition: A gathered and mixed multitude; people joined together from different groups.
senses.usage_conditions: In فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ الْآخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا, it describes people brought together as a collective, with the lexical association of a gathering from disparate groups.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fold, wrap, roll up, or enclose one thing in another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes physical wrapping or enfolding; related usage describes wrapping the head in clothing or placing a bird’s head under its wing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To involve or entangle an enemy in difficulty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A warfare expression associated with subduing an enemy and inflicting many wounds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become tangled or confused, or to become luxuriant, abundant, and densely intermingled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to herbage, a collection of trees, or another thing that becomes closely gathered or dense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wrap or enwrap oneself in a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive clothing construction, equivalent in sense to enveloping oneself in a garment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a young man’s face, to become continuous or full with beard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the beard becoming continuous across the face.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an affair, to become complicated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative use for a matter whose elements become entangled or difficult to disentangle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rhetorical construction in which several items are followed by corresponding descriptions or predicates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The correspondence may follow the original order (regular) or reverse and disorder it (inverted or confused).
Includes a covering for the leg or foot and a botanical envelope such as a pericarp or glume.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lock or tress of hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A discrete gathered lock of hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Describing a she-camel whose hump is heavily enveloped in fur.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive expression for the covered or enveloped appearance of the hump.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person with a compact, well-knit bodily frame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a tightly formed or compact physical constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who is inarticulate or stammers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative association with a tongue that seems twisted or entangled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose thighs draw close through corpulence; hence a heavy, slow person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The bodily and behavioral descriptions are reported as related lexical uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold or deny someone his due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use with a person’s right or entitlement as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Interwoven patches or clumps of grass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of dense, intertwined growth in the ground.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Tangled, confused, luxuriant, and dense growth meaning represented.
Botanical envelope use is grouped under the covering meaning.

cautions: The supplied contextual gloss “is wound” for 75:29 is not used to create a separate sense; the lexical evidence supports becoming intertwined or closely joined.
أَلْفَاف is retained as the attested adjectival citation form because the packet does not securely establish a singular public headword for this Quranic usage; it is kept distinct from لَفِيف.
